C0807.title: 175 Malicious npm Packages Leverage CDN to Conceal Phishing Attacks
C0807.summary: In October 2025, Socket disclosed that attackers had published at least 175 malicious packages to the official npm registry, and Chinese media followed up in November 2025. The packages accumulated more than 26,000 downloads, used CDNs to hide malicious behavior, and conducted phishing attacks, posing security threats to downstream users.
